title: Russian admiral: the phenomenon's reality isn't in question

tellings.quote: Russia and I remember sitting down with this Admiral and he said to my interpreter he's like look if you're here to ask me whether or not the phenomenon is real the door is right over there

plain: In 1990s Russia, a Russian admiral told the filmmaker James Fox, through his interpreter, that if Fox had come to ask whether the UFO phenomenon was real, "the door is right over there." Fox, who has spent years investigating UFOs for documentaries, tells it as something he sat through himself, as a sign that senior Russian military men took the phenomenon's reality as settled.
